sections.Profile:
"Foto Finish," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in January 1961, is a one-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with a horse racing theme. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, it features two flippers, two pop bumpers, seven passive bumpers, and a single gobble hole. The game includes a "score-to-beat" window, where operators could set a challenging score for players to surpass.
